body:
1. Align `commands/agb.md` and `skills/agb/SKILL.md` with `bin/agb.mjs` (`migrate [--rollback] [--force-rollback] [--force] [--break-lock]`, `sidecar [repo-path] [--port <port>]` without `--open`, `pool drain [repo-path]`, `import-brain <id-or-prefix> <repo-path>`, `bootstrap [--force] [--force-reinstall]`, plus `brains` and `sweep` rows in `commands/agb.md`).
2. Wire optional `[repo]` on `agb doctor [repo]` in `bin/agb.mjs`, update `COMMANDS.probe.args = '[widths] [model]'`, validate `agb migrate` flags by index (consuming values for `--token`, `--uninstaller-dir`, `--agy-bin`, `--baseline` and failing closed on unknown flags), and add `[--force]` to `commands/agb-bootstrap.md`.
3. In `mcp/server.mjs`, validate `targetCwd` is an existing directory (`-32602` on error), resolve `agb_plan` `--out` against `targetCwd`, fail closed in `resolveAgbEntry` when `bundled === true`, and handle `ping`.
4. In `lib/doctor.mjs`, require `parseAgyModels(stdout).length > 0` in `checkAgyAuth` and share `modelsPromise` in `runDoctor()`; in `lib/bootstrap.mjs`, unlink dangling retired maintainer-skill symlinks pointing to `/antigravity-booster/skills/<retired>`; in `lib/migrate.mjs`, check `STAGE_COPY_EXCLUSIONS` in `treeSize()` and `step3Snapshot()`.
title: Align /agb router, CLI migrate flag validation, MCP server targetCwd & ping, and doctor/install hygiene
